title: Api rest 40k
description: Sample REST API for Warhammer 40k Primarchs and their Chapters, built to show how I structure a Spring Boot API: Controller → Service → Repository, record DTOs with validation, explicit mappers and domain exceptions with ProblemDetail (RFC 7807).
Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot 4.1 (WebMVC, Data JPA, Validation, Security, Actuator), PostgreSQL 16 + Flyway, JWT (jjwt), springdoc-openapi and Docker Compose.

Highlights: stateless JWT auth (public GET, write requires Bearer), Flyway as only schema source (V1 schema + V2 seed with 8 primarchs/chapters), pagination, OpenAPI docs and full-stack run with `docker compose up --build`.
